slides.subheadline: Dr. Kanokporn Tangsuan died on October 5, 2023, after dining.

items.label: Jeffrey Piccolo
items.body: Her husband alleged staff promised to exclude her allergens.

slides.headline: A Different Referee. Not Immunity.
slides.subheadline: The danger: account terms invoked far beyond their apparent purpose.

items.label: Disney’s demand
items.body: Individual arbitration instead of a courtroom hearing.

items.label: Contested reach
items.body: Piccolo disputed coverage; no ruling endorsed Disney’s theory.

slides.headline: Disney Backed Down. The Case Ended.
slides.subheadline: Disney abandoned its arbitration demand after public backlash.

items.label: August 2024
items.body: Disney dropped its demand for arbitration.

items.label: February 27, 2026
items.body: Piccolo voluntarily dropped the lawsuit; it cannot be refiled.
